pages.title: Ritual Preparations: Chalks
pages.text: To summon spirits from the $(#ad03fc)Other Place$() in *relative* safety,$(br)you need to draw a fitting pentacle using chalk to contain their powers.$(br)
White chalk is used to draw the most basic pentacles, such as for our first ritual.$(br2)More powerful summonings require appropriate more advanced chalk, see Chalks for more information.$(br)

pages.title: Usage
pages.text: Right-click on a block with the chalk to draw a single glyph. For decorative purposes you can repeatedly click a block to cycle through glyphs. The shown glyph does not matter for the ritual, only the color.$(br)
